ISTJ – Logistician.description: These individuals tend to be serious, matter-of-fact, and reserved. They appreciate order and organization and pay a great deal of attention to detail. They like to plan things out in advance and place an emphasis on tradition and law. They are responsible and realistic and can be described as dependable and trustworthy.

ISFJ – Defender.description: These individuals are friendly, responsible, and reserved. They are service and work-oriented, committing to meeting their obligations and duties. They are loyal, considerate, and place a lot of focus on the care of others. They are non-confrontational and value an orderly and harmonious environment.

INFJ – Advocate.description: People with this personality type are serious, logical, and hardworking. They are also compassionate, conscientious, and reserved. They value close, deep connections and are sensitive to the needs of others, but also need time and space alone to recharge.

INTJ – Architect.description: These people are highly independent, self-confident, and prefer to work alone. They are analytical, creative, logical, and driven. They place an emphasis on logic and fact rather than emotion and can be viewed as perfectionists. They tend to have high expectations of competence and performance for themselves and others.

ISTP – Crafter.description: People with this personality type are fearless and independent. They love adventure, new experiences, and risk-taking. They tend to be quiet observers and are not well attuned to the emotional states of others, sometimes coming across as insensitive or stoic. They are results-oriented, acting quickly to find workable solutions and understand the underlying cause of practical problems.

ISFP – Artist.description: These individuals are quiet, friendly, easy-going, and sensitive. They have a strong need for personal space and time alone to recharge. They value deep connection and prefer to spend time with smaller groups of close friends and family. They are highly considerate and accepting, avoiding confrontation and committed to their values and to people who are important to them.

INFP – Mediator.description: These people are creative, idealistic, caring, and loyal. They have high values and morals and are constantly seeking out ways to understand people and to best serve humanity. They are family and home-oriented and prefer to interact with a select group of close friends.

INTP – Thinker.description: People with this personality type are described as quiet, contained, and analytical. They are highly focused on how things work and on solving problems, and tend to be good at logic and math. They are more interested in ideas and theoretical concepts than in social interaction. They are loyal and affectionate to their closest friends and family, but tend to be difficult to get to know.

ESTP – Entrepreneur.description: These individuals are energetic, practical, and sociable. They are quick-thinking and thrive in dynamic environments. They enjoy taking risks and are often seen as adventurous and spontaneous. However, they can be impulsive and insensitive at times.

ESFP – Entertainer.description: These individuals are enthusiastic, sociable, and spontaneous. They love being the center of attention and enjoy entertaining others. They are optimistic and fun-loving but can struggle with long-term planning and organization.

ENFP – Champion.description: These individuals are enthusiastic, creative, and sociable. They are free spirits who enjoy exploring new ideas and possibilities. They are optimistic and passionate but can struggle with routine and details.

ENTP – Debater.description: These individuals are creative, quick-witted, and energetic. They enjoy debating and exploring new ideas. They are innovative and adaptable but can be argumentative and easily bored.

ESTJ – Director.description: These individuals are efficient, organized, and decisive. They are natural leaders who value structure and order. They are practical and responsible but can be inflexible and overly critical.

ESFJ – Caregiver.description: These individuals are sociable, caring, and responsible. They are committed to helping others and value harmony and cooperation. They are organized and dependable but can be overly sensitive and people-pleasing.

ENFJ – Protagonist.description: These individuals are charismatic, empathetic, and persuasive. They are natural leaders who inspire and motivate others. They are organized and idealistic but can be overly idealistic and prone to burnout.

ENTJ – Commander.description: These individuals are natural leaders who are decisive, efficient, and confident. They are strategic thinkers who excel at organizing and executing plans. They are goal-oriented and driven but can be impatient and dominating.
